evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu
To the house its king spoke:
I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth.
It was then, in a ‘dark goat’, that towards his king, on the lord Ningirsu, Gudea looked.
“Build his house!,” he ordered him.

segments.text_en: Epistemic uncertainty and voyage to Nina
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant, counseled about the message:
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know.
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother.
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me.
After reaching Bagara—house hanging over the river, he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
Hero, you spoke to me, let me do it right for you, Ningirsu, let me build your house for you
From Gudea, his offering and his prayer, his king, the lord Ningirsu, received from him.
He sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water. He went to Shiny-Gatumdu
I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother. I am a no-father-haver, you are my father.
His lady, the offering and the prayer, Shiny-Gatumdu received from Gudea.

segments.text_en: Arrival in Siraran and dream recitation
evidence: Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven, his greatness was like the earth.
There was one woman. Who was it, who was it not? ... She had the tablet of the stars on her lap.
Secondly, it was a hero ... he drew the plan of the house.
In front of me stood a shiny basket, a shiny mold was made ready
His mother, Nanše, answered the governor: “My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you.”
The man (who was) great like the heaven ... it is surely my brother Ningirsu.
Let me give you instructions, let my instructions be heeded.
to the hero who loves gifts, to your king, lord Ningirsu ... he will receive your small word, as if it was a mighty word.

segments.text_en: Crafting ritual gifts and presentation at Eninnu
evidence: The righteous shepherd Gudea learnt big, and now he will perform big.
He made it straight for him, for the lapis chariot.
With his beloved harp, ‘dragon of the land’ ... to his king, lord Ningirsu, in Eninnu, the white Anzu, he enters.
Joyfully he entered to him in the house.

segments.text_en: Second incubation and petition for the sign
evidence: To Šugalam, the terrible place, the place of rendering justice ... he brought in.
Juniper, the pure tree of the mountain he placed on the fire, cedar incense, the incense of the gods
Ningirsu, I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not.
Hero, your remote, like the heaven, ‘heart’, son of Enlil, lord Ningirsu, I, what can I learn from you?

segments.text_en: Ningirsu's direct revelation and cosmic covenant
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house.
My house, Eninnu, founded by An, its ‘me’ is bigger than all the other enormous ‘me’
With the founding of my house, may abundance arrive.
On that day (when) your arm is touched with fire, I will teach you my sign.

segments.text_en: Extispicy and moral purification of the city
evidence: He is stretching the hand in a white goat. He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good.
The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire.
A mother does not accuse a son, accusations, a son to his mother does not speak.
The Anunna of area-Lagash, in order to build the house of Ningirsu, with Gudea in offering and prayer, they stood with him.

segments.text_en: Civic levy and international assembly of labor
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land, in the totality of all of his lands.
In the ‘tribe’ of Ningirsu, he made a levy for him.
Elam came to him from Elam. Susa came to him from Susa.
For the construction of Ningirsu’s house, they assembled for Gudea in his city Girsu.

segments.text_en: Expeditions and resource gathering across distant lands
evidence: To the land of cedar, where no man enters, for Gudea, the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
To the land of stone, where no man enters, Gudea for the Lord Ningirsu made way for him.
From Kimaš, the mountain of copper ... the copper he excavated there
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain.

segments.text_en: Ground surveying and ritual molding of the first brick
evidence: The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, he raised to Eninnu.
Gudea placed clay in the mold. The cultic order emerged.
He shook the mold, he threw the brick to dry.
(About) his brick placed in the mold, Utu was pleased with it.

segments.text_en: Display of the brick and final omen confirmation
evidence: He lifted the brick from the mold, it is a shiny throne raised to heaven.
He raised the brick, he brought it to his people
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good.
Gudea lying by the top, he slept, the word dawned on him.

segments.text_en: Divine assembly assistance and sevenfold blessing of the temple
evidence: Enki places the foundation of the house, Nanše, the daughter of Eridu cared for the omen taking.
The mother of Lagash, Shiny-Gatumdu, bore its bricks in flows.
he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax.
The governor built the house, he made it grow, he made it grow like a large mountain

segments.text_en: Erection and naming of dedicatory stelas
evidence: His stone erected in the mighty courtyard, ‘the stela, king filling the courtyard, Lord Ningirsu made Gudea known from Girnun,’ as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in Kasurra, ‘the king, flood of Enlil, no-haver of opponent, Lord Ningirsu, on Gudea looked righteously,’ as name of that stone he named.
His stone erected in front of Šugalam, ‘by the name of his king the mountains tremble, Lord Ningirsu, Gudea, his throne he made firm,’ as name of that stone he named.

segments.text_en: Sanctuary installation of slain heroic trophies
evidence: He build the house of his king with righteousness. The righteous shepherd Gudea made it grow together with heaven and earth.
At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang, Sagar, the hero, the six headed ram, he seizes there.
Because they are dead warriors, he placed their mouths at the libation place

segments.text_en: Cosmic integration, provisioning, and concluding doxology
evidence: The fear of Eninnu, on all the lands, like a garment, it covered.
From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries, From the mighty oven, large cakes, large croissants(!?).
Gudea, governor of Lagash, placed its foundation.
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised!
